test_multistart_fallback_selects_closest: test the multistart fallback logic that selects the closest valid root to the nominal initial guess
test_multistart_filters_numerical_errors: test that the multistart solver filters out roots with numerical errors regardless of physics outcome
test_multiple_roots_found_flag: test that multiple_roots_found is set to true when distinct roots exist across guesses
test_configurable_num_guesses: test that the configurable multistart_num_guesses parameter controls the number of solver guesses and triggers JIT compilation
run_extended_lengyel_standalone: run the extended lengyel standalone solver with multistart Newton-Raphson mode and configurable initial guesses
